answer_1.quote: we introduce CARD, a cross-modal agent-driven framework that leverages natural language input to generate and edit 3D residential designs.
answer_1.outputs: 3D residential designs and editable floor plans from natural language input

answer_2.quote: we chose FID, PSNR(Huynh- Thu and Ghanbari, 2008), and SSIM metrics.

answer_4.quote: We invited experts and ordinary users to create 100 residential description manually... and generate residential floor plans using our model, which were then mixed for the experts to judge.
answer_4.guideline: Users were asked to identify real floor plans among a mixed collection of real and generated plans; experts scored consistency and layout rationality using a defined scale (60=passing, 70=medium, 80=good, 90=excellent).
